phrases.text: Your Bluetooth is named after a Viking.
A thousand years ago, King Harald Bluetooth ruled Denmark.
He was famous for uniting Denmark and Norway.
In the 1990s, an engineer was reading about him,
while building a way to unite phones and computers without wires.
So he borrowed the king's name.
And the logo? It's Harald's initials, H and B, in Viking runes.
What's on your Bluetooth right now? Comment below, and subscribe for more.
